stories.question: Which antibiotic resistance genes are in these stool metagenomes?

why.route: The question asks for an analysis of the user's own sequenced samples; the router sends that to nextseek_query, whose pipeline agent offers the nf-core run.
why.pipelines: Mouse stool DNA from an untreated and a vancomycin-treated mouse, untargeted Nextera XT shotgun libraries (LibraryStrategy WGS, LibrarySource METAGENOMIC): reads of a whole community, which taxprofiler profiles. Resistance genes are a funcscan screen, but funcscan reads assemblies (A.ASM) and these are reads only: they must be assembled first (nf-core/mag for a metagenome), so the reply says so and builds nothing. Offering funcscan on the reads, or taxprofiler (which names organisms, not genes), is wrong.
